name: grpstats
expr: m = grpstats(X, g); [m2, s2] = grpstats(X, g, {'mean', 'std'}); ms = grpstats(X, g, 'sum'); mn = grpstats(X, g, 'numel'); [dm, ds, dc] = grpstats(X, g); dm11 = dm(1,1); ds11 = ds(1,1); ds22 = ds(2,2); dc11 = dc(1,1); dc22 = dc(2,2);
comment: MATLAB grpstats: per-group statistics. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on default-mean, multi-fn cell-of-strings, sum, std, numel aggregators. Other aggregators (var, sem, min, max) supported in numkit. DEEP-PROBE c178: with NO whichstats arg the default OUTPUTS are [means, sem, counts] (MATLAB's nargout default) — numkit only emitted the means, so [m,sem,counts]=grpstats(X,g) threw 'Index 1 exceeds array size 0'. Now ds = standard error of the mean (std/sqrt(n)) and dc = per-group counts. Cell-of-fn output ordering matches MATLAB's nargout indexing. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship grpstats in core (statistics package only); reports N/A.
